static_traits.name: 林若彬
static_traits.occupation: A social science student (currently pursuing a master's degree)
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends to confide in, but reduces socializing due to fear of failing the defense; feels friends do not fully understand their worry.
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before; no equal degree of fear and anxiety in the past.
static_traits.language_features: Nervous but hopeful, high cooperation; clear expression, relatively good logic, able to concretely state automatic thoughts and emotions; tends to seek comfort and reassurance from others.

basic_info.main_problem: I persistently worry my master's thesis defense will fail; as the defense approaches the fear intensifies, causing high stress, anxiety, and insomnia, affecting my concentration and overall physical and mental state.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to receive support and guidance, reduce the fear of failing the thesis defense, and improve focus and work ability.

core_beliefs: Failure equals all efforts being negated/reset to zero

special_situations.event: When small errors occur while writing the thesis
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is a small error in the thesis, the committee will think my research is flawed, causing me to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks comfort and reassurance from classmates and professors to reduce fear
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My research has flaws, they will think I am no good, I will fail

special_situations.event: When thinking about the upcoming thesis defense
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I forget content or perform imperfectly on the spot, I will be negated and fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 向他人寻求安慰与保证
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will forget everything at the defense; the outcome will surely be failure

special_situations.event: 收到导师的正面反馈后
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' positive evaluations do not prove I can pass the review; the committee may hold the opposite view
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuing to seek more external proof and comfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My advisor says my work is solid, but the committee will not see it that way

special_situations.event: While continuously writing and preparing the thesis
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the thesis is not perfect enough, it means I will fail and all efforts are in vain
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly fixating on the worst case and seeking external comfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I am not perfect I will fail; all my effort will be wasted

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized, seen as capable, and pass the defense smoothly
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated by reviewers, being seen as incompetent, past efforts lose meaning
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety and control by seeking external reassurance and keeping high vigilance

object_relations.self_representation: A student/candidate who is easily negated
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh reviewers or others who may negate oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others (such as a mentor or counselor) give positive feedback or comfort
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Lin Ruobin tends to think this positive information is unreliable, worrying that others do not understand the degree of her fear or that the committee will hold the opposite view
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintain a supportive and gentle tone, invite the client to concretize positive evidence and sources of worry, use open-ended questions to explore whether the 'committee's view' is speculation or fact; avoid confrontational correction.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about the defense scenario or making small errors in writing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projects the inner fear of failure onto the reviewers, presuming they will think the research is flawed and negate the self
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Labels their assumptions and distinguishes facts from speculation, encourages describing verifiable evidence; stable, slow tone, avoiding judgment.

manifestations: Believing once the defense fails, many years of effort will all 'go down the drain'
Feels uneasy and fearful about the committee's unpredictability
Reducing social contact out of fear; hard to share vulnerability deeply with others

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worried about appearing incompetent and does not dare to fully express fear and vulnerability
Still cautious after receiving positive feedback; continuing to seek external reassurance

positive_force: Continued engagement in thesis writing, with academic persistence
Proactively seeking support and advice from classmates and mentors
Mentor gives positive feedback (believing their work and argumentation are fairly solid)
negative_force: A way of thinking marked by catastrophizing and predicting failure
Discounting positive information (disregarding others' positive feedback)
Overreacting to small mistakes and mental filtering
Social withdrawal, disrupted sleep and eating
过度依赖外部安慰与保证

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent worry and anxiety about thesis defense failure (accompanied by insomnia)
antecedent: When thinking about the upcoming thesis defense
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing cognitions and predictions of negative evaluations; equating failure with all efforts being negated; dependence on external comfort and reassurance
target_behavior.function: Escapes uncertainty and potential failure to gain a sense of safety (by seeking comfort and reassurance)
target_behavior.consequence: Study focus is impaired, sleep and eating rhythms are disrupted, social withdrawal occurs, and overall physical and mental state declines
